name: The Long Con
source:
In the not-so-quiet town of Barreleye Point live you and your two friends, Swan and Lamie. Unfortunately peace doesn't seem to follow your little group.

Between the constant, ever-growing stream of deaths trailing behind you and the visions that haunt your dreams, you need to figure out what's happening and why it's happening to you.

[From [url=https://bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb.itch.io/the-long-con]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你和你的两个朋友Swan和Lamie住在不太安静的Barreleye Point小镇。不幸的是，和平似乎并没有伴随着你们的小团体。

在身后不断、不断增长的死亡流和困扰你梦境的幻象之间，你需要弄清楚正在发生什么以及为什么它会发生在你身上。

[来自[url=https://bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb.itch.io/the-long-con]itch.io[/url]]
